observations: Photo 0 shows a PS4-style controller (DualShock layout) on top of a black box/cover.
The box/cover has the text 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' and 'POSTED ON'.
No console (PS4 fat) is visible in the photo.
No visible model/version label (fat/slim/pro) is readable from the photo.

claims.claim: Ps4 fat hacked with with fc26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows a controller on a box/cover; no PS4 console, no 'fat' identification, and no visible evidence of hacking or game list (FC26 + 8 games).

risks.risk: The item may not be a PS4 fat console (could be a different console or only a controller/box).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full PS4 console (front + back ports) with the model/version visible (fat vs slim/pro) and the console powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed PS4 fat (worst case: treat as controller/uncertain console) until the console identity is proven.

risks.risk: Hacked status and game availability may be untrue or not working (offline/expired, missing games, or requires re-install).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of the console booting into the hacked menu/store and showing the game library including FC26.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/without confirmed games (worst case: hacked games not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI, controller count) can change value significantly.
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo of everything included: console, power cable, HDMI cable, controller(s), and any storage/extra items.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable that matches only the core item with minimal accessories (worst case: incomplete bundle).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the actual PS4 console (front and back) showing it is PS4 fat (model/version visible).
Send a video clip powering on and navigating to the game list showing FC26 and the total games claimed.
Send a photo of all included accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller(s), and any storage).
response.reason: The photo does not show the PS4 console or any evidence of hacking/game contents, so a worst-case price cannot be reliably matched to the correct item type (console vs controller/box).
